description: This Java class implements an external event producer for JMS messaging within the Fineract project, handling message partitioning, producer management, and asynchronous message sending.

classes.name: JMSMultiExternalEventProducer
classes.description: A Spring component that produces external JMS events asynchronously, managing connections, sessions, and message dispatching.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Sends a batch of events partitioned by IDs, managing producer sessions and asynchronous message dispatch.

methods.name: closeSessions
methods.description: Closes JMS sessions to prevent resource leaks.

methods.name: obtainProducers
methods.description: Creates JMS sessions and message producers based on configured producer count.

methods.name: createSendingTask
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task to send a list of messages via a JMS producer.

methods.name: mapPartitionsToProducers
methods.description: Distributes message partitions across producers using consistent hashing.

methods.name: waitForSendingCompletion
methods.description: Waits for all asynchronous message sending tasks to complete.
